purpose: Normalize SCOPED_ENGAGEMENT_PROPOSED evidence across all customer-facing ICV offerings without replacing offering-specific scope, pricing, maturity, source authority, acceptance or professional/legal requirements.

offering_specific_preservation.governance_boundary_validation: Engagement-specific price/IP/publication/support/travel/retention; validator pilot is not production runtime.
offering_specific_preservation.admitted_code: Exact-scope quote; assessment does not create production admission/release authority.
offering_specific_preservation.stegcrm: Managed-pilot terms; no source write-back or synthesized probability/qualification.
offering_specific_preservation.hydrasafe: May carry fixed fee, deposit, milestones, external-professional fee treatment and reference-rights terms from its facility SOW; professional work remains separately governed.
offering_specific_preservation.gp10: Written exact scope and fixed-fee/cost-plus amount required before accepting payment; stop-work if source package materially differs.
offering_specific_preservation.governance_observatory: Support fee does not redefine immutable v0.1.0 release.
offering_specific_preservation.knowledgevault: Pilot/migration/provider terms must distinguish v0.1.9 release from later main capabilities.
offering_specific_preservation.ecosystem_chat: Preview/evaluation terms only; live distributed execution/provider consumption not sold as proven.
offering_specific_preservation.steglearn: Pilot terms preserve parent/steward review and privacy boundaries; no generally released education platform.

required_separate_evidence: authentic acceptance attributable to an authorized customer counterpart
applicable legal-entity/signature/professional requirements for the specific engagement
prohibitions: Do not infer authority from sender address alone
Do not treat proposal delivery/opening as acceptance
Do not treat a generic reply, GitHub reaction, payment intent or CRM state as acceptance
Do not define electronic-signature sufficiency or legal enforceability in this envelope
No inference of payment from acceptance

crm_boundary: Proposal creation/delivery does not create or mutate Lead, Deal, probability, qualification or source-system state.
runtime_boundary: Proposal/SOW scope does not activate software/runtime/release/credential/custody authority.
privacy_boundary: Private customer content, provider message/thread IDs, signatures, credentials and confidential source materials remain outside public proposal evidence unless separately authorized.

disposition_rules.allow_scoped_engagement_proposed_when: Every required field is explicit, offering package semantics are preserved, proposal identity/version is fixed, and proposal delivery is authentically evidenced.
deny_or_fail_closed_when: required proposal field is missing or silently inferred
proposal contradicts offering package maturity/source authority/pricing/acceptance boundary
proposal represents unreleased/unproven substrate as released/proven
acceptance is being inferred from proposal existence or delivery
